items.hook: SpaceX crash site on moon revealed by South Korean orbiter
items.body: An out-of-control SpaceX rocket that crashed into the moon earlier this week did, in fact, leave an impact crater, according to images from a Korea AeroSpace Administration lunar orbiter that caught before-and-after photographs

items.hook: Voepass Linhas Aéreas Flight 2283 crashes near Vinhedo, São Paulo, killing all 62 people on board.
items.body: Voepass Flight 2283 was a scheduled domestic Brazilian passenger flight from Cascavel to Guarulhos. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.body: Shannon Eastin is a former NFL official; she was the first female official of the National Football League (NFL). Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Gothic War: Battle of Adrianople: A large Roman army led by Emperor Valens is defeated by the Visigoths. Valens is killed along with over half of his army.
items.body: The Gothic War of 376–382 was one of several Gothic Wars in Roman history in which the Goths fought against the Roman Empire. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Ashley Collins is an American Contemporary Painter.
items.body: Collins's massive scaled paintings are found in blue chip collections and museums worldwide. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Could geoengineering ‘ice arches’ help preserve Arctic sea ice?
items.body: Researchers are investigating whether artificially thickening ice blockages between Canada and Greenland could prevent huge amounts of sea ice from flowing south to melt

items.hook: Wang Yintai was a politician in the Republic of China.
items.body: He belonged to Fengtian clique, later he became an important politician during the Provisional Government of the Republic of China and the Wang Jingwei regime. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Drought and heat push Europe’s power grid to breaking point
items.body: High temperatures and low water levels have forced several countries to shut down nuclear reactors just as citizens turn up their air conditioning, forcing energy prices to spike and raising the threat of blackouts

items.hook: As a direct result of the Watergate scandal, Richard Nixon becomes the first president of the United States to resign from office. Vice President Gerald Ford becomes president.
items.body: The Watergate scandal, or simply Watergate, was a political scandal in the United States involving the administration of President Richard Nixon. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: American Transcendentalist philosopher Henry David Thoreau publishes his memoir Walden.
items.body: Transcendentalism is a philosophical, spiritual, and literary movement that developed in the late 1820s and 1830s in the New England region of the United States. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: The Italian prosecuting magistrate Antonino Scopelliti is murdered by the 'Ndrangheta on behalf of the Sicilian Mafia while preparing the government's case in the final appeal of the Maxi Trial.
items.body: Antonino Scopelliti was an Italian prosecuting magistrate, murdered by the 'Ndrangheta on behalf of the Sicilian Mafia. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: GEAR is a Japanese long-running non-verbal theatre show that originates in Kyoto and incorporates elements of technology, skilled performance arts.
items.body: It is the first long-run show with original content in Japan. The world is stranger than it lets on.
